text:
```yaml
name: Duplicate Issue Detection

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]

jobs:
  detect_duplicates:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Detect Potential Duplicates
        uses: wow-actions/potential-duplicates@v1
        with:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          threshold: 90
          label: potential-duplicate
          comment: |
            Potential duplicate found. Please check the following issues:
            
            {{#each similarIssues}}
            - [#{{this.number}}] {{this.title}} (similarity: {{this.similarity}}%)
            {{/each}}
            
            If this is indeed a duplicate, please close this issue and reference the original.
```
